contrasts.line: Nibble means tiny, careful mouthfuls. Munch means steady crunching sounds.
Nibble is slow and tiny. Gulp is taking drink or food down in one go.
Nibble is careful and tiny. Gobble is rushed, messy mouthfuls.
Sipping is for drinks. Nibbling is tiny bites of food.
Munch has steady crunching sounds. Nibble is tiny and careful.
Munch is crunchy mouth work. Gulp is down the throat in one go.
Munch is steady and crunchy. Gobble is rushed and messy.
Sipping is a little drink. Munching is chewing food, on and on.
Gulp is down in one go. Nibble is tiny, careful mouthfuls.
Gulp is a fast throat action. Munch is steady crunchy mouth work.
Gulp is one fast throat action. Gobble is rushed, messy mouthfuls of food.
Sipping makes a drink last. Gulping finishes it in one swallow.
Gobble is rushed and messy. Nibble is tiny and careful.
Gobble is rushed, messy mouthfuls. Munch is steady crunching sounds.
Gobble is messy food rushing. Gulp is down the throat in one go.
Sipping is small and careful. Gobbling is eating fast with a mess.
Nibbling is tiny bites of food. Sipping is tiny drinks.
Munching is steady chewing. Sipping is drinking, a little at a time.
Gulping downs the drink in one go. Sipping takes the smallest taste at a time.
Gobbling is fast messy eating. Sipping is slow careful drinking.

meta.scrub_note: devour swapped for sip: gobble/devour proved judge-inseparable in every frame; sip also makes gulp's drink dimension coherent. Full read by claude during judge triage: every flagged sentence adjudicated (rewrite or recorded waiver), unflagged sentences read for frame sanity.
